All Addl. Central Provident Fund Commissioners (Political States)

Subject: Grant of exemption from the provisions of EDLI Scheme, 1976 under
Section 17(2A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952 — regarding.

Sir,

Please refer to this office circular letter of even number dated 08.05.2014 on the
above subject wherein all regional offices were requested to compile region-wise/office-wise list
of establishments where EDLI exemption/relaxation have been granted in the format prescribed

in the above referred circular and all RPFC-I, Incharge of the Regions were requested to send
the above information, region-wise within 10 days.

Z. The Central Provident Fund Commission reviewed offices of NCR on the EDLI
exemption and as per the discussion the revised format for the information required is annexed
herewith.

3 All Addl. Central Provident Fund Commissioners (Political States) are requested to
forward the above information for all the offices under their jurisdiction Region-wise/Office-wise
to Sh. B.K. Batra, RPFC-II(Pension) latest by 13.06.2014. It may be ensured that above
information pertaining to any RO/SRO is only furnished through office of the ACC (Political State)
concerned. Further, it may kindly be noted that any information in this regard received directly
from any field office will not be entertained by this office.

4. The circular dated 08.05.2014 stands modified accordingly.

Encl.: As above.

(MJP. VARGHESE)
Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner (Pension) _

Copy to:- All RPFCs, Incharge of the Regions, with the request to forward the information in
the prescribed format to their respective ACC(Political State) for further compilation at their end
and onwards transmission to Headquarters Office.

(M)P. VARGHESE)
